name: Independent cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 25

clue.text: These cards are meant to be played
See 24
Determined? Raised, backing dealt flush
Subtleties including ‘One Spade’ will prove nuisances
Reg is gathering hand in and relaxing
Minor player makes overtrick?
Is hookéd by bridge, mainly, returning for recess
Diana’s found a house in wrong sequence
Cards should be played thus, without thinking?
South’s quit gloomy card game
Restrained about start of rummy, then played out
Measure to stop court card appearing on board
Lanky one, dupe, loses a pound to a king
Mark and I called unsystematically
‘Straight’? Indeed
One’s stake, confronting Edward, aroused attention
It’s a gamble, we hear, to go one better with Queen
I must pass, deviously conveying a suit
Perfectly sound? A trick’s the criterion, apparently 4 Made match, with time, enjoying partnership
Revokes, causing some surprise, generally, and upset
Allowable feature of Acol I cited
Manipulate ineptly, with awkward smile about what’s dealt
Great loss on pontoon, leaving only part of our capital?
Reversal for fellow with high card after a spell
Shuffling at crib, Leo will be found in a carriage
Welshman with a nine maybe holds game up?
Collapse for socialite, one in card circles, about 50
Knave — one withdrawn from the pack?
